title: halenia parviflora
intro: Halenia parviflora, commonly known as the halenia plant, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Halenia parviflora are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
